import os,re,collections,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
T=G['Test input']; H,W=24,24
D4g=[lambda a,b:(a,b),lambda a,b:(a,W-1-b),lambda a,b:(H-1-a,b),lambda a,b:(W-1-a,H-1-b),
     lambda a,b:(b,a),lambda a,b:(H-1-b,a),lambda a,b:(b,W-1-a),lambda a,b:(W-1-b,a)]
seen=set();out=[]
for start in sorted((r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if T[r][c]==2):
    if start in seen: continue
    comp={start};st=[start];seen.add(start)
    while st:
        a,b=st.pop()
        for g_ in D4g:
            p=g_(a,b)
            if 0<=p[0]<H and 0<=p[1]<W and p not in comp: comp.add(p);st.append(p)
    vals=[(a,b,T[a][b]) for a,b in comp if T[a][b]!=2]
    v=vals[0][2] if vals else 0
    out += [(a,b,v) for a,b in comp]
    print(len(comp),'value',v, sorted(vals)[:3])
print('done; count:',len(out))
